document: SMDS Recovery — Missing & Recovered Knowledge (Gap-Fill Pass)
method: Systematic re-read of both PDFs plus visual rasterisation of every model-detail page

SECTION_A_COVER_RULES_RECOVERED.label: Cover — exact chain from nominal to main bar

A1_nominal_cover_definition.applied_to: reinforcement NEAREST to the concrete surface (e.g. links in a beam, not main bars)

A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.rule: Nominal cover to the LINK must be such that the resulting cover to the MAIN BAR is at least: bar_dia_main (or equivalent dia for pairs/bundles of ≥3 bars) + Δcdev
A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.derived_formula: c_link ≥ (c_main_required − link_dia)  where  c_main_required = bar_dia_main + Δcdev
A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.no_links_present_rule: Nominal cover ≥ bar_dia + Δcdev directly to bar
A2_cover_to_main_bar_via_link.note: Previous extraction stated the rule verbally but did NOT encode the chain: cover_to_link + link_dia + cover_to_main ≥ bar_dia_main + Δcdev

A3_surface_treatment_addition.rule: Where special surface treatments used (e.g. bush hammering): add expected depth of treatment to nominal cover

A5_durability_cover.rule: Cover for durability governed by exposure class — specified by Designer per EC2 Clause 4.2. This manual gives TYPICAL values only; Designer must confirm.
A5_durability_cover.note: Previous extraction did not flag that the typical cover values in Chapter 6 are NOT the durability table; the full exposure-class table is in EC2, not reproduced here.

A6_fire_cover.rule: Cover for fire resistance is expressed as AXIS DISTANCE (centre of bar to concrete surface), not nominal cover. Size of members and axis distance are specified by the Designer per BS EN 1992-1-2.
A6_fire_cover.axis_distance_definition: distance from CENTRE of reinforcing bar to surface of concrete
A6_fire_cover.not_same_as: nominal cover (which is to outermost steel = link face)
A6_fire_cover.note: Previous extraction mentioned fire but did not encode the axis-distance vs. nominal-cover distinction as a computable rule

A7_fire_spalling_threshold.rule: IF nominal cover to outermost steel > 40mm (i.e. axis distance to MAIN reinforcement > 70mm) THEN there is a danger of concrete spalling in fire → provide surface reinforcement mesh: spacing ≤ 100mm, diameter ≥ 4mm
A7_fire_spalling_threshold.note: Was in previous extraction but the 70mm threshold for AXIS DISTANCE (not nominal cover) was not made explicit

A8_beam_top_cover_note.rule: For beams: top cover may be determined by slab or transverse beam reinforcement — not solely by nominal cover to the beam's own bars

A9_section_5_8_reference_clarification.rule: References to 'see 5.8' in Sections 6.3.2 and 6.4.2 mean: use the equivalent bar diameter (bn = ø√nb ≤ 55mm) from Section 5.4.5 (bundled bars) to determine cover for grouped bars
A9_section_5_8_reference_clarification.source: Sections 6.3.2 and 6.4.2 (note 'see 5.8'); bn formula from Section 5.4.5 p43
A9_section_5_8_reference_clarification.status: EXTRACTED — formula from 5.4.5; section 5.8 itself UNRESOLVED (not in these PDFs)

MS2A.applies_when: Wall continues above AND below the slab — simple continuity

rebend_edge_bars.rule: Where construction requires edge bars cast flush with wall face then rebent to project into slab — proprietary systems are available

SECTION_E_SECTION_5_15_STATUS.label: Section 5.15 — Secondary beam lever arm check
SECTION_E_SECTION_5_15_STATUS.source: Referenced at Section 4.2.2 note 3 (page 26 PDF1) and in context of secondary beam increased cover
SECTION_E_SECTION_5_15_STATUS.what_it_covers: Where secondary beam reinforcement increases top cover, check that resulting reduction in lever arm is satisfactory
SECTION_E_SECTION_5_15_STATUS.section_5_15_page: Estimated ~page 50–60 of full manual (not in either PDF extract)
SECTION_E_SECTION_5_15_STATUS.action: DEPENDENCY — must be extracted from the full manual's Section 5.15
SECTION_E_SECTION_5_15_STATUS.note: The rule itself is a design check (z = d - x/2 recalculation); the detailing consequence is that secondary beam top cover drives the effective depth check. No numerical rule can be encoded without Section 5.15.

SECTION_F_RECOVERED_BEAM_RULES.label: Beam rules recovered — partially or wholly omitted

F1_wide_shallow_beam_corbel_rule.rule: Where wide shallow beams required with narrow columns, may be necessary to provide design transverse top steel at the column position to cater for CORBEL ACTION, in addition to shear links
F1_wide_shallow_beam_corbel_rule.applicability: Most likely where precast slabs used with no transverse beams; tying action must also be considered

F2_beam_4hr_fire_supplementary.rule: For 4-hour fire resistance: supplementary reinforcement may be required where nominal cover exceeds 40mm. Trigger is axis distance to LINK reinforcement > 70mm.
F2_beam_4hr_fire_supplementary.was_omitted: Not fully encoded — the axis-distance-to-link threshold (70mm) was present but not coded as a decision rule

F3_beam_top_cover_from_slab.rule: Top cover to beam bars may be determined by slab reinforcement or transverse beam reinforcement passing over the beam top
F3_beam_top_cover_from_slab.source: Section 6.3.2, page 74 — note under nominal cover
F3_beam_top_cover_from_slab.DXF_impact: When generating beam cross-section at slab junction, top cover to beam bars = cover_to_slab_bar + slab_bar_dia

F4_compression_transverse_flange_min_reb.rule: As,min for transverse reinforcement in top flange of flanged beams: As,min ≥ 0.0015 × hf × l  (where hf = flange depth, l = span)
F4_compression_transverse_flange_min_reb.was_omitted: Listed in previous extraction but not included in the parametric formula section

F5_curtailment_al_default.rule: If designer does not specify curtailment length: Detailer shall assume al = 1.25d
F5_curtailment_al_default.was_omitted: Was present but not encoded as a default fallback decision rule

all_four_conditions_required_simultaneou: Qk (characteristic imposed load) ≤ Gk (characteristic dead load)
Variation in span length ≤ 15% of longest span
F6_simplified_curtailment_conditions_com.was_omitted: Previous extraction listed conditions but omitted the effective-span cap formula

F7_hanger_bar_rule_complete.area_rule: At least max(20% of maximum support top steel area, compression steel required) must be carried to 25mm from each support
F7_hanger_bar_rule_complete.placement: Hanger bars to be placed inside main top bars at support (MB1)
F7_hanger_bar_rule_complete.was_omitted: 20% area rule was present; 'inside main top bars' placement from MB1 was present; the exact 'whichever is greater' logic between 20% area and compression area needed was implicit

F8_bottom_bar_span_end_bay_rule.rule: For end bays: lengths of alternate bars are 'a' and 'b' (from bending moment diagram). For internal bays: all bars = max(a, b), alternately staggered.
F8_bottom_bar_span_end_bay_rule.source: Section 6.2.2, Figures 6.3-6.4, page 50 (stated for slabs; beam equivalent via simplified rules)
F8_bottom_bar_span_end_bay_rule.was_omitted: End-bay vs internal-bay distinction for bottom bar curtailment not separately encoded for slabs

G1_column_tension_bar_max_spacing.rule: Maximum spacing of TENSION bars in column: 175mm
G1_column_tension_bar_max_spacing.note: Previous extraction gave compression bar maximum (300mm) and listed '175mm' as tension in one line but it was not encoded as a named constraint

G2_column_32mm_spacing_lapping_allowance.rule: When considering minimum spacing of bars of 32mm size or greater, allowance must be made for lapping of bars
G2_column_32mm_spacing_lapping_allowance.practical_meaning: At laps, two 32mm bars side by side need clear spacing of max(bar_dia, dg+5mm, 20mm) computed on the LAPPING bars — can govern minimum column width

G3_column_concrete_grade_cap.rule: Column concrete grade must not exceed 1.4 × concrete grade of intersecting slab or beam UNLESS special measures taken to resist bursting forces
G3_column_concrete_grade_cap.was_omitted: Was present; decision rule was not encoded as a computable check

G4_column_5_8_bundle_cover.rule: Cover to bundled bars in columns = cover to EQUIVALENT bar size bn (see Section 5.8 / Section 5.4.5: bn = ø√nb ≤ 55mm)
G4_column_5_8_bundle_cover.status: EXTRACTED (bn formula from 5.4.5); Section 5.8 itself UNRESOLVED

SECTION_H_RECOVERED_GENERAL_RULES.label: General rules recovered — previously summarised only

H1_nominal_lap_minimum_for_nominal_bars.rule: Lap lengths provided for nominal bars etc. shall NOT be less than max(15 × bar_size, 200mm)
H1_nominal_lap_minimum_for_nominal_bars.was_omitted: Was present in slab section but not encoded as a separate general constraint independent of the alpha-factor table

H2_slab_simplified_curtailment_condition.rule: The simplified curtailment method for slabs (Figures 6.3 and 6.4) may be used ONLY when analysis is carried out for the single load case of all spans loaded per 5.1.3(1)P of UK National Annex of EC2 AND no shear reinforcement is required
H2_slab_simplified_curtailment_condition.section_5_1_3: UNRESOLVED — Section 5.1.3 is not in these PDFs; it is a UK NA load combination rule in EC2

H3_fabric_lap_area_allowance_for_slab_de.rule: When providing detailing information for coffered slabs with fabric, if Designer does not specify the additional area required for laps, 22% will be assumed for 300mm laps

H4_slab_cover_for_detailing_information_.rule: Standard cover for detailing information: 20mm for internal conditions, 40mm for external conditions (slab detailing information section 6.2.3)

H5_direct_support_reduced_anchorage.rule: For direct supports (slab supported by wall or column — Figure 6.1a): anchorage length beyond face of support may be reduced to d, but NOT less than max(0.3 × l_b,rqd, 10ø, 100mm). Exception: where loading abnormally high or point loads close to support → refer to EC2 Sections 8 and 9.
H5_direct_support_reduced_anchorage.was_omitted: The exception condition (abnormal loading / point loads) was not encoded in the previous extraction

H6_indirect_support_full_anchorage.rule: For indirect supports (slab supported by another beam — Figure 6.1b): full anchorage length l_bd applies from line of contact. No reduction permitted.

H7_partial_fixity_slab_top_bars.rule: Minimum top reinforcement at support where partial fixity exists: 25% of maximum required reinforcement in span (not less than As,min). May be REDUCED TO 15% for an END support.
H7_partial_fixity_slab_top_bars.was_omitted: 15% end-support reduction was present but not coded as a separate conditional rule

H8_moment_connection_corner_bar_rule_bea.rule: For L-bar beam-to-edge-column connection: a STANDARD bend radius may normally be used PROVIDED a bar of the same size OR GREATER is placed INSIDE THE CORNER, normal to it. If no corner bar is present, a NON-STANDARD bend may be required.
H8_moment_connection_corner_bar_rule_bea.was_omitted: Was present; the 'same size or greater' quantification of the corner bar was not encoded

H9_wide_beam_narrow_column_corbel_trigge.rule: IF beam_width > column_width + 2 × d THEN consider design transverse top steel at column for corbel action (plus tying)

H10_direct_support_transverse_wire_excep.rule: For direct supports: l_bd may be taken LESS THAN l_b,min provided there is at least ONE transverse wire welded WITHIN the support, and at least 15mm from the face of the support
H10_direct_support_transverse_wire_excep.was_omitted: The 15mm from face of support dimension was present in previous extraction but the 'one transverse wire welded' specific condition was not separately encoded as a decision rule

SECTION_I_RECOVERED_DRAWING_NOTATION.label: Drawing notation and scheduling rules recovered

I1_bar_notation_AP_AS_meanings.AP: Alternately Placed — bars of alternating marks placed in the same zone
I1_bar_notation_AP_AS_meanings.AS: Alternately Staggered — bars of same mark staggered alternately
I1_bar_notation_AP_AS_meanings.EF: Each Face — bar on each face of member (e.g. side bars)
I1_bar_notation_AP_AS_meanings.P_A_S_for_links: Placed As Shown — links placed as shown on elevation
I1_bar_notation_AP_AS_meanings.source: Working drawing examples Sections 6.2.4 and 6.3.4, pages 51-52, 62-63, 79-80

I2_slab_bar_count_bracket_notation.rule: Where multiple zones of similar bar marks occur: show total count followed by sub-counts per zone in brackets, e.g. '20H10-63-150T1 (12) (8)'
I2_slab_bar_count_bracket_notation.was_omitted: Was present in a list; not encoded as a drawing-convention rule with example

I3_link_elevation_notation.format: count/spacing — e.g. '19/300' means 19 links at 300mm centres; multiple zones: '19/300   5/200   13/150'
I3_link_elevation_notation.P_A_S_suffix: '37 H12 07 LINKS P.A.S' — 37 H12 links, bar mark 07, placed as shown
I3_link_elevation_notation.CLOSERS_notation: '29 H12 08 300 LINK CLOSERS' — link closers at 300mm

I4_TEF_notation.TEF: Top Each Face — bar on each face at top of member, e.g. side bars in a broad beam: '2 H12 09 TEF'

I5_spacer_bar_notation_beam.rule: Spacer bars between multiple layers of beam main bars: notation '4 H25 10 SPACERS' on elevation; dia ≥ max(25mm, main bar dia)
I5_spacer_bar_notation_beam.source: Model Detail MB1, page 82; Section 6.3.4 page 79

I6_beam_UB_notation.rule: U-bar suffix on bar notation: '2 H20 02 UB' — marks bar as a U-bar; also 'U-BARS LONG LEG B1' specifies which leg is the reference layer

I7_curtailment_mark_30deg.rule: Curtailed bars in elevation are identified by short 30° oblique lines at the bar end, with appropriate bar mark. If bars are congested, ends should be clarified with pointers.
I7_curtailment_mark_30deg.was_omitted: Was partially described; 30° angle not encoded

I8_slab_fan_zone_bars.rule: Bars set out from a radius in a 'fan' zone: indicator line located on datum radius for measuring pitch. End of bars located to datum. Notation includes s.o.p (setting out point).

I9_cranked_bent_bars_on_plan.rule: Cranked and bent bars are sometimes drawn on plan as though laid flat. Sections and notes MUST be provided to clarify if some bars are fixed flat and some upright, to avoid site confusion.

I10_representational_beam_table_format.rule: Representational method for beams: one general elevation + specific cross-sections + table. Table columns: BEAM, DIM1, DIM2, reinforcement zones (A, B, C, D, E, L1, L2, L3), SECTION references. Bar location letters cross-reference elevation to table. Position of each beam shown on key plan with grid lines.
I10_representational_beam_table_format.was_omitted: Described but table column format not fully encoded as a data structure

I11_slab_fabric_chain_dashed_line.rule: Fabric reinforcement on plan identified by chain double-dashed line (not a solid or dashed line)
